description:
Explorer thumbnails for 434 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit. SageThumbs 2K is a modern, crash-isolated Windows 11 shell extension written in Rust that rebuilds the classic SageThumbs. It gives File Explorer thumbnails for 434 file types Windows can't preview on its own — camera RAW, HEIC/AVIF, Photoshop, DjVu, ebooks and comics, video frames, 3D-print files and a long tail of obscure formats — plus a right-click image toolkit (convert, resize, rotate, OCR, color picker, metadata strip, combine-to-PDF/CBZ) and a console/AI CLI. Free for personal use.
## TL;DR **≡ƒåò New** - **Atari ST DEGAS and Tiny pictures get thumbnails** (`.pi1`-`.pi3`, `.pc1`-`.pc3`, `.tny`, `.tn1`-`.tn3`) - **Commodore 64 Koala Paint and FLI pictures get thumbnails** (`.koa`, `.kla`, `.fli`) - **GIMP brushes, image hoses and patterns get thumbnails** (`.gbr`, `.gih`, `.pat`) - **Seven more classic image formats get thumbnails** (`.wbmp`, `.otb`, `.mtv`, `.aai`, `.avs`, `.hrz`, `.xwd`) - **Windows app packages and Chrome extensions show their own icon** (`.appx`, `.msix`, `.appxbundle`, `.msixbundle`, `.crx`) - **Text files can show their first page as a thumbnail, off by default** (`.txt`, `.md`, `.json`, `.xml`, `.log`, `.nfo`, `.diz`, `.reg`, `.rtf`, `.csv`, `.ini`) - **More names for formats SageThumbs 2K already reads**: JPEG (`.jif`, `.jfi`, `.pjpeg`, `.pjp`, camera `.thm`), BigTIFF (`.btf`, `.tf8`), SGI (`.rgb`, `.rgba`, `.int`, `.inta`), Sun raster (`.im1`, `.im8`, `.im24`, `.im32`), `.epsf`, Illustrator templates (`.ait`), Amiga HAM (`.ham`, `.sham`), Office themes (`.thmx`), OpenDocument drawing templates (`.otg`) and Radiance `.pic` - **GoPro `.lrv`, Matroska 3D `.mk3d` and transport-stream `.m2t` / `.trp` videos get frame thumbnails** - **Quick preview has a Show in folder button** - **Quick preview reloads the picture when the file changes on disk, and F5 reloads it by hand** - **Settings warns when Explorer is set to show icons instead of thumbnails, and fixes it in one click** - **Settings shows a short What's new note once after an update** - **Settings Γû╕ File types can show only the file types you have ticked** (#85) **≡ƒöü Changed** - **A smaller install**: the translations are stored compressed, the command-line tool is a small launcher over the one engine (it needs `SageThumbs2K.exe` beside it), and it carries its own icon **≡ƒ⌐╣ Fixed** - **The picture tile in the right-click menu is drawn once** - **Escape and Cancel close the thumbnail-cache rebuild questions in Settings without rebuilding** - **3MF files built only from beams get thumbnails** - **3MF beam lattices with `ballmode="all"` get a ball at every beam end** - **A damaged 3MF file can no longer keep its thumbnail busy for a long time** - **A photo whose metadata lists thousands of people can no longer slow Explorer down** - **Ogg audio files (Speex, Vorbis, Opus, FLAC) get their thumbnails faster** - **CorelDRAW, Affinity, Paint.NET, Paint Shop Pro and 3-D model files show their program's icon again** - **The format mark and the checkerboard reach types whose own program draws their thumbnails** - **Illustrator files saved without PDF data show their artwork** - **Turning a format off no longer removes a file-type setting another program wrote after SageThumbs 2K** - **If the screenshot overlay's drawing engine cannot start, the overlay now says so and closes instead of opening with annotation tools that draw nothing** - **`st2k doctor` no longer blames Explorer when run as administrator, and no longer warns about an approved-extensions list Windows 10 and 11 ignore** (#84) - **Settings can no longer crash when you switch pages**
Read more: everything in 5.0.0 - **Atari ST DEGAS and Tiny pictures get thumbnails.** DEGAS (`.pi1`, `.pi2`, `.pi3`), DEGAS Elite compressed (`.pc1`, `.pc2`, `.pc3`) and Tiny (`.tny`, `.tn1`, `.tn2`, `.tn3`) pictures, in all three ST resolutions, are read by SageThumbs 2K's own decoder, with each picture's own palette. DEGAS Elite files saved without the colour-animation block at the end, as many are, read too. - **Commodore 64 Koala Paint and FLI pictures get thumbnails** (`.koa`, `.kla`, `.fli`), read by SageThumbs 2K's own decoder in the C64's colours. - **GIMP brushes, image hoses and patterns get thumbnails** (`.gbr`, `.gih`, `.pat`): the brush or pattern itself, and an image hose's first brush. - **Seven more classic image formats get thumbnails**, each read by SageThumbs 2K's own decoder: wireless bitmaps (`.wbmp`), Nokia over-the-air bitmaps (`.otb`), MTV ray-tracer pictures (`.mtv`), Dune AAI (`.aai`), AVS X (`.avs`), slow-scan television (`.hrz`) and X Window dumps (`.xwd`). - **Windows app packages and Chrome extensions show their own icon.** `.appx`, `.msix`, `.appxbundle` and `.msixbundle` show the logo the package manifest names (a bundle, the logo of the app inside it), and `.crx` shows the icon the extension's manifest names, however large the extension is. A package without one keeps the stock icon. - **Text files can show their first page as a thumbnail, off by default.** With text thumbnails turned on in Settings, `.txt`, `.md`, `.json`, `.xml`, `.log`, `.csv`, `.ini`, `.reg` and `.rtf` files show their opening lines drawn as a page, and `.nfo` and `.diz` files are drawn in the DOS code page they were written in, so their block art lines up. Off, these types are left to Windows as before. - **More names for formats SageThumbs 2K already reads:** JPEG (`.jif`, `.jfi`, `.pjpeg`, `.pjp`, and the camera `.thm` preview), BigTIFF (`.btf`, `.tf8`), SGI (`.rgb`, `.rgba`, `.int`, `.inta`), Sun raster (`.im1`, `.im8`, `.im24`, `.im32`), `.epsf`, Illustrator templates (`.ait`), Amiga HAM (`.ham`, `.sham`), Office themes (`.thmx`), OpenDocument drawing templates (`.otg`) and Radiance `.pic`. Radiance pictures (`.pic` and `.hdr`) whose header has a line ahead of the `#?RADIANCE` signature, as some renderers write it, now read as well. - **GoPro `.lrv`, Matroska 3D `.mk3d` and transport-stream `.m2t` / `.trp` videos get frame thumbnails**, read the way their parent formats (MP4, Matroska and MPEG transport streams) are. - **Quick preview has a Show in folder button.** It opens the file's folder in Explorer with the file selected. - **Quick preview reloads the picture when the file changes on disk, and F5 reloads it by hand.** Save the file in an editor and the preview shows the new version, at the zoom and scroll you had. A file still being written is waited for, so a half-saved file is never shown. - **Settings warns when Explorer is set to show icons instead of thumbnails.** When Windows' own "Always show icons, never thumbnails" box (Folder Options, View) is ticked, no program's thumbnails show, which looks like SageThumbs 2K is broken. Settings now says so under every page, and Fix it turns the setting off. If Explorer puts it back, Folder Options opens on its View tab so you can untick the box yourself. - **Settings shows a short What's new note once after an update**, with a link to that version's release notes. Dismiss hides it until the next update; a fresh install never shows it. - **Settings Γû╕ File types can show only the file types you have ticked** (#85). A new switch, **Show only the selected file types**, lists just the ticked formats, so checking what is selected no longer means scrolling the whole list; the search box still narrows it. A type unticked while the switch is on keeps its row until the switch is turned off, so the list does not jump while you edit. It changes only the view, never which types are ticked. - **A smaller install.** The translations are stored compressed, and only the language in use is unpacked, once, when a SageThumbs 2K program starts. The command-line tool carries its own icon, so the install folder no longer holds a loose icon file; an upgrade removes the old one. The command-line tool `st2k.exe` is now a small launcher that runs the engine already inside `SageThumbs2K.exe`, so the install carries one copy of the engine instead of two. Every command, script and the MCP server work as before, through a symlink to `st2k.exe` too. A copy of `st2k.exe` on its own, away from `SageThumbs2K.exe`, now stops with one line saying so: link to the installed `st2k.exe` instead, or put the install folder on your `PATH`. If the `SageThumbs2K.exe` beside it is older (an update still waiting on a restart), `st2k` says so in one line instead of opening the Settings window. - **The picture tile in the right-click menu is drawn once.** When a label in the SageThumbs submenu was wider than the picture, Windows could draw the tile twice, side by side. The tile now takes the width of the widest label and shows once. - **Escape and Cancel close the thumbnail-cache rebuild questions in Settings without rebuilding.** The questions now offer Cancel, which Escape and the close box answer, and Cancel is the default button, so pressing Enter declines too.
